rationale: The bid-ask spread of 123 bps is prohibitively wide relative to any realistic intraday target, meaning execution costs alone would consume a significant portion of any edge. While price is clearly in a strong intraday downtrend (gapped up to $103.49, now sitting at 2.9% of the day's range near the $100.76 low), the combination of thin early volume (47k shares), no EMAs or ATR data to calibrate stop placement, and the costly spread make reliable risk management impractical. The setup mechanics favor continuation lower, but the structural liquidity constraints make this untradeable at acceptable risk-reward.
